title: WEIBULL.DIST: 5,999 of 6,000 on a fresh held-out gate against the production kernel
status_plain: The WEIBULL.DIST body was identified as a legacy x87 per-operation double-rounded compilation unit -- the pdf is a division-first, left-to-right C expression with every operation double-rounded through a spilled local -- and then gated on 6,000 fresh rows against the PRODUCTION kernel, missing one row by 2 ULP. The identification corpora (b27's 5,400-row pdf corpus, b27b) are separate from the gate. The build is not restated anywhere near the figure.
